---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---



```{r}

library(tidyverse)

sales_data <- tibble(
  month = rep(seq.Date(from = as.Date('2025-01-01'), by = 'month', length.out = 6), 2), 
  product = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 6), # don't forget the each here 
  sales = 1:12 #creates a vector (numerical) from 1 to 12
) 

# print(sales_data, n = 24) # n = 24 to print all the data

sales_tsibble <- sales_data %>%
  as_tsibble(index = month, key = product)

sales_tsibble
# in <...> we have the type of the object --> <chr> means text/character, <dbl> means numeric

index(sales_tsibble)
key(sales_tsibble)

ggplot(sales_tsibble, aes(
  x = month, 
  y = sales,
  color = product #distinguishes the two lines

)) +
  geom_line() #draw lines

```

geom_line()    → lines
geom_point()   → dots
geom_col()     → bars
geom_boxplot() → boxplots

ggplot()       → "Here's my canvas"
aes()          → "Here's what my variables mean"
geom_*()       → "Here's what I want to draw"
